svg.title: A ramp judge reads the area between the CDFs
svg.desc: Two Gaussians N(0,1) and N(1,1) with the best bounded-Lipschitz ramp judge, and the gap F minus G between their CDFs. The ramp has slope L = 0.43 and sup norm a = 0.57, so it slopes over a window of width 2.65 centred at 0.5. Its gap equals L times the area of F minus G over the window, 0.343. The whole area under F minus G is W1 = 1.
svg.text: judge h, drawn scaled to fit (it runs from -a to +a)
whole area under F - G = W1 = 1.00
orange part x L = 0.343 = Dudley distance
